observed_behavior: Leading byte stores align destination to4bytes, followed by16-byte groups,4-byte words and atmost3tailbytes.
Word-loop size comparisons use signed CMPLTI. Counts with highbit set require separate arithmetic/valid-memory qualification.
Plain SDK C differs for initially unaligned addresses: it keeps those fills bytewise instead of aligning then usingword stores.
limits: Object comparisons identify lineage only; objects must not supply emitted firmware or source arrays. Need source reconstruction and decoded memory/return checks.
